title_en: Your Body Gives Off About as Much Heat as a 100 W Bulb #Shorts
desc_en:
At rest, a person gives off roughly 100 watts of heat, about as much as an old incandescent bulb. Put 500 people in a theater and that is around 50 kW. That is why standing close keeps us warm.

Sources: University of Illinois Physics (resting human power ~100 W); Big Think (500 people at ~100 W each = 50 kW).
Directed by L.S.M · Dreamloom Studio (Heosang Gongbang)

#shorts #science
desc_ko:
가만히 있어도 사람 몸은 약 100W의 열을 냅니다. 옛 백열전구 하나만큼입니다. 극장에 500명이 모이면 약 50kW. 그래서 가까이 있으면 따뜻합니다.

출처: 일리노이대 물리학과(안정 시 약 100W), Big Think(500명 × 100W = 50kW)
